View 4326 West 10th Ave V6R rent availability including the monthly rent price and browse photos of this 2 bed, 1 bath, 935 Sq. Ft. apartment. 4326 West 10th Ave is currently on market.
Fully-Furnished and Fully-Renovated Spacious 1950s Suite4326 West 10th Avenue, at Discovery. Available now, this 935-square foot furnished suite combines 1950s spaciousness and quality with modern kitchen, bathroom and lighting. Fully furnished including bedding, towels, cookware, dishes, cutlery, glasses etc.  Pretty well all that you need to live here is what's in your suitcase. The suite features new TRIPLE-glazed windows (three layers of glass) for maximum street-noise reduction and heat insulation. Appliances include a self-cleaning range with induction cooktop and a noiseless dishwasher. Excellent public transportation to UBC via #99 B-Line, #14. 15-minute bike ride to campus centre. Rent includes heat and hot water. The suite is located in a very well-maintained 12-suite apartment building that has been in the same family since it was built in the 1950s. A resident caretaker takes excellent care of the building. Building features include a laundry room with secure bicycle storage and video surveillance, security cameras covering building entrances and exterior walkways, cellphone-controlled entry system, bright interior and exterior lighting. We would be happy to show you this very-impressive suite.  Please call or write to arrange a tour.  Please note that tenant’s insurance is required. Sorry, no pets.
